action_summary: Grandview C-4 joins Cohort 1 of Real World Learning initiative forming South KC micro-region with Center and Hickman Mills supported by Kauffman implementation grants
District initiates MVA planning and design team embedding career-connected learning and coaching across high school curriculum
Establishment of Advanced Manufacturing Pathway at Grandview High School in partnership with KC National Security Campus (Honeywell)
Adoption of 5-year Comprehensive School Improvement Plan (CSIP 2022-2027) under MSIP 6 embedding Success-Ready Students and Workforce Excellence
First student cohort completes 200-hour welding coursework with 100% pass rate on American Welding Society (AWS) industry certification exams
Regional senior MVA attainment rises from 67% (2023-24) to 79% (2024-25) across 34 participating districts; Grandview C-4 maintained in active network
Board formally reviews and approves evaluation of district Real-World Learning program assessing college prep placement career center enrollment MVA attainment and STEM participation
Presentation of 2024 DESE MSIP 6 Annual Performance Report earning 127.5/200 points (63.7%) with 86.6% continuous improvement points earned
Board briefing on expansion of shared Real World Learning pathways across graphic design barbering cosmetology welding healthcare and advanced manufacturing
Appointment of Dr. Stephanie Amaya as Superintendent effective July 2026; Dr. Amaya explicitly highlights Real World Learning and AVID as foundational priorities
Board receives formal update on continuation of T&L Welding partnership (200 instructional hours AWS certifications) and reviews postsecondary transitions
Board formally reviews and adopts preliminary operating budget for 2026-2027 fiscal year and updates Career Ladder incentive allocations
Board convenes regular September meeting; reviews student behavior support (BIST) violence prevention (Rose Brooks) and community educator grants
